clips.title: Vibe Coding Is a Recipe for Illusion
clips.summary: A weak specification lets generated code look confident while the real authority problem stays invisible.

clips.title: Velocity Makes Weak Specs Dangerous
clips.summary: AI coding makes weak specifications more dangerous because implementation now appears faster than intent can be governed.

clips.title: The Missing Blueprints
clips.summary: When teams cannot point to the shared specification, separate workers and agents reconstruct intent from symptoms.

clips.title: Choose What Deserves Authority
clips.summary: The practical question is which surfaces deserve authority and how failures push those surfaces back into revision.
